Case note: CS(COMM) 1138/2022
Client: Bhavana Mehra (textile trader, Vadodara)
Opposing party: Das Exports
Court: Gujarat High Court, before Justice Arvind Bhargava
Filed on: 19 March 2022
Claim amount: Rs 2,96,00,000
Issue: geographical-indication dispute. The rival product uses the protected regional name on its label.
Advice given: Rely on the registered GI certificate and seek an injunction against the infringing label.
Outcome: An injunction against the infringing label was granted.
Recommended next step: Seek damages.
Witness: Kavya Bhatt
